text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and Super Creek were absent from 
the Takarazuka Kinen as well. However, an 
illustrious roster of runners was set to 
compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Unless I can beat every single person 
here, I'll never become the Umamusume of 
the Year." Inari One fired herself up.
